data.name: Cli_RootDescription
data.value: QuickER - a CLI that generates C# code from an ER diagram or database

data.name: Cli_Opt_Schema
data.value: Input ER diagram JSON file (the app's save format)

data.name: Cli_Opt_Out
data.value: Output folder for the generated code

data.name: Cli_Opt_Config
data.value: Generation option settings file (quicker.json)

data.name: Cli_Cmd_Generate
data.value: Generate C# code from an ER diagram JSON

data.name: Cli_Opt_Connection
data.value: Connection string (e.g. Server=.;Database=Foo;Integrated Security=true;TrustServerCertificate=true)

data.name: Cli_Cmd_Scaffold
data.value: Connect directly to a database and generate C# code from its schema

data.name: Cli_Opt_Provider
data.value: Target database type (default: sqlserver)

data.name: Cli_Opt_Namespace
data.value: Root namespace of the generated code (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_Split
data.value: Output each category in a separate file and namespace (overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_RepositoryDialects
data.value: Dialects for which to also generate QuickER Repositories (comma-separated, multiple allowed; e.g. sqlserver,sqlite). When omitted, a single dialect is derived from --provider. Overrides the settings file.

data.name: Cli_Opt_RuntimePackages
data.value: Do not include the runtime (fixed code) in the generated code; rely on references to the NuGet packages QuickER.Runtime.* instead (default false; can be combined with EF Core generation; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_ApiDocs
data.value: Additionally output one API reference Markdown ({baseName}.g.md) (default false; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_RemoteContracts
data.value: Additionally generate remote-capable Repository interfaces I{Entity}RemoteRepository (CRUD, save, named queries only; I{Entity}Repository keeps all methods and inherits it) (default false; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_RemoteServices
data.value: Include the HTTP client implementation of the remote surface in the main output, and additionally output an ASP.NET Core server implementation to {baseName}.RemoteServer.g.cs (implies the remote surface --remote-contracts automatically; default false; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_Opt_ExcludeUnboundedBinary
data.value: Exclude unbounded binary columns (varbinary(max), BLOB without a length) from the generated Repository's SELECT/UPDATE; INSERT keeps all columns (default false; overrides the settings file)

data.name: Cli_SchemaFileNotFound
data.value: Schema file not found: {0}

data.name: Cli_SchemaNewerFormatWarning
data.value: Warning: the schema file was saved in a newer format (v{0}) than this version supports (up to v{1}). Unsupported data will be ignored.

data.name: Cli_SchemaImportFailed
data.value: Failed to import the schema from the database: {0}

data.name: Cli_RepositoryDialectUnsupported
data.value: QuickER Repository (GenerateRepositories) does not support the dialect '{0}'. Supported dialects: {1}

data.name: Cli_GenerationAborted
data.value: Aborted due to a generation error.
